message:
Structural Dynamicist, the clamped cross-beam hanger (C3) carries the device entirely from below with margin (E44 total static hung load TMD plus frame).

Plain words first: eight friction clamps share one small hung weight, so each sees little load. Numbers that decide: hung weight 9.81 kN, eight Type F3 M16 clamps each rated 4.0 kN Safe Working Load (SWL) with Factor of Safety (FOS) 4 to 1 give 32.0 kN capacity, safety factor 3.26 (E45 slip safety factor 8xM16) (E39 Lindapter | Type F3 Beam Flange Clamp).

Serviceability and Crowd Loading Specialist, flange bending does not control the hanger (E41 slip safety factor 8xM16).

Plain words first: the clamp point load spreads into the girder bottom flange, so local bending is small. Numbers that decide: about 1.23 kN per clamp against the 4.0 kN SWL rating, capacity factor 3.26 (E45 slip safety factor 8xM16) (E39 Lindapter | Type F3 Beam Flange Clamp).

Under-Deck Integration Designer, this keeps no deck change with Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) lock-off for inspection (E39 Lindapter | Type F3 Beam Flange Clamp).

Plain words first: malleable-iron hot-dip galvanised clamps with no drilling or welding install from below deck. Numbers that decide: same 9.81 kN hung load, same 3.26 factor (E44 total static hung load TMD plus frame) (E45 slip safety factor 8xM16).
